Burhan Oil & Trade ServicesOur people, our priority

Add a temporary contract worker

For individuals hired for a few days or weeks under a contractor agreement. They count under the division they work for; when the contract ends they are released from the project automatically (records are kept, and “+ New contract” brings them back).

After saving, upload the signed agreement (Contracts tab) and his training certificates and medical — the profile then shows whether he is cleared to start.

Training matrix

Sign in to load the training matrix…

Each worker needs the trainings of their Designation plus any extra roles (set in their Profile). “—” means not required for that person. A training counts when the course name on the worker's Training record contains the required name — e.g. “Working at Height – Level 2” counts for “Working at Height”. Click a row to open that worker's Training tab.

Monthly HSE Report

Burhan Oil & Trade ServicesThink safe, work safe, home safe

TBT records from the project links — all projects

Every completed TBT of the month, all projects in one file. The full records (signatures) are deleted 60 days after the request — download each month. One project only: Project Details → the project → Toolbox talks.

Log an HSE activity

Safety performance
Company LTI record before the tracker

If Burhan has never had a lost-time injury, choose LTI-free start and enter the company start date — the dashboard then shows "no LTI since" that date. If there was an LTI, choose Our last LTI date. The counter uses it until a newer LTI is recorded in the tracker, then restarts from that LTI automatically. It applies to the company and division views; a single project counts from its own first entry. If you know the LTI-free man-hours up to a month end, enter them — man-hours logged in the tracker after that month are added on top.
